scientific_integrity: All-order bounds and equality criteria are derived by a forest-incidence argument; the distinct extremal count invokes the classical Cayley theorem. Computation does not substitute for the all-order proof. No independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite simple forests, marked open-adjacency one-point types and named parameters; no higher-rank types. Equality-family and minimum-order classification proved for all positive marked-set sizes, with finite enumeration solely corroborative. Existing exact prior formulations may remain undiscovered.
title: Cayley rigidity of maximal open-adjacency types in finite forests
